notes: V25 (CR 115.1, 601.2c via 602.2b): Garruk, Savage Herald's -2, 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to another target creature.' Two targets, one per 'target': the first is your 4/4 Brute, the second your own 3/3 Pal (another target creature may be yours). The Brute deals 4 to the Pal, which dies; the Brute is not damaged. Before V25 the ability had one target slot, both creatures were bound to the damage role, and the 4 damage hit both (the Brute died too).
